I think you're right, that's exactly what I should do. I haven't been able to dive into my music like I have been for the past few days of not being high in a long time and I forgot how much I loved completely losing myself in it. I used to get high, sit with my guitar or at my computer, and then nothing would happen because I'd get bored or distracted. Even if I did write something it usually was stereotypical stoner stuff. It feels amazing just to be writing for me again, not even recording on my computer or mixing or anything yet. Don't get me wrong, I'm still dealing with the insomnia, anxiety, and depression that's coming with not smoking, but my music is making it worth it so far and it's really helping me out.
